title: Fast Furnaces
description: Makes the cooking time of all vanilla recipes 5x faster. Incredibly useful.
body:
If you ever thought that smelting in Minecraft was too slow, this may be for you. With this datapack, everything cooked within a furnace, blast furnace, smoker, or over a campfire is 5x faster.
